messages.content: You are a precise biomedical information extraction assistant. Follow the requested output format exactly and never add explanations.

Find duplicate entities for the item and an alias that best represents the duplicates. Duplicates are those that are the same in meaning, such as with variation in tense, plural form, stem form, case, abbreviation, shorthand. Return an empty list if there are none.

item: "supplements containing biotin"
set: ["supplements containing biotin", "supplements containing potassium", "hair, skin, or nail supplement containing biotin", "biotin", "nutritional supplements", "mineral supplements", "over-the-counter supplements", "iron supplements", "stop biotin and biotin-containing supplements at least 2 days before thyroid blood test", "products containing potassium", "medicine containing sacubitril", "medication containing aliskiren", "avoid potassium supplements or salt substitutes containing potassium unless specifically told by doctor", "prescription medicines containing alcohol", "another medicine containing bupropion", "another medicine containing spironolactone"]

Respond with a JSON object with exactly these fields:
  "duplicates": list of exact matches to items in the entities set that are duplicates of the item
  "alias": best entity name to represent the duplicates, ideally from the entities set
